result.markdown:
Yes. I’d shortlist **Blumers, Maliganis Edwards Johnson, and Snedden Hall & Gallop** first, with **BDN Lawyers** and **ACT Law Associates** also worth considering depending on the type of claim.

I checked current Canberra firms offering no-win-no-fee arrangements and cross-checked them against the **2026 Doyle’s Guide plaintiff-side compensation rankings**, which are based on peer nominations/interviews rather than paid placement. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My Canberra shortlist

| Firm | Why I’d consider them | No-win-no-fee |
|---|---|---|
| **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers** | **My first choice for a broad personal-injury claim.** Leading ACT firm in 2026 for both work-injury and motor-vehicle compensation; Amy Burr is ranked Preeminent. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Yes |
| **Maliganis Edwards Johnson** | Another **top-tier choice**, particularly for workplace, motor-vehicle and public-liability claims. The firm is Leading in the 2026 Doyle's rankings and has several highly ranked lawyers. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Yes |
| **Snedden Hall & Gallop, Lawyers** | Strong independent Canberra option. Richard Faulks is ranked Preeminent for work injury and motor-vehicle claims in 2026. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Yes |
| **BDN Lawyers** | Good option particularly for **workplace injury/compensation**; Richard Baker has been repeatedly recognised by Doyle's, and the firm is Recommended in 2026. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | Yes |
| **ACT Law Associates** | Interesting choice if you want a **smaller Canberra-based firm** focused exclusively on injured people. It explicitly advertises no-win-no-fee with $0 upfront legal costs for accepted matters. [actlawassociates.com.au](https://actlawassociates.com.au/services/personal-injury?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Yes — explicitly** |
| **Shine Lawyers Canberra** | Larger national firm with a Canberra office and an explicit No Win No Fee* offering covering motor accidents, workplace injuries and public liability. Conditions apply. [www.shine.com.au](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/act/canberra?utm_source=chatgpt.com) | **Yes*** |


### If it were my claim

I'd probably get **2–3 free initial consultations** rather than immediately signing with the first firm. My starting three would be:

1. **Blumers** — strongest overall credentials in the current ACT rankings.
2. **Maliganis Edwards Johnson** — particularly strong across several compensation categories.
3. **Snedden Hall & Gallop** — strong alternative with highly ranked plaintiff-side lawyers.

The current 2026 Doyle's rankings put **Blumers and Maliganis Edwards Johnson in the Leading tier** for ACT work-injury claims; they are also the two Leading firms for motor-vehicle compensation. [doylesguide.com](https://doylesguide.com/rankings/work-injury-compensation-lawyers-law-firms-plaintiff-act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **“no win, no fee” doesn't necessarily mean “no cost if you lose.”** You need to ask specifically about disbursements, barrister/medical-expert costs, the uplift fee, and whether you could become liable for the other side's costs in particular circumstances. ACT costs agreements are subject to the *Legal Profession Act 2006 (ACT)*. [www.millnerknight.com.au](https://www.millnerknight.com.au/no-win-no-fee/act/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened to you** (e.g. workplace injury, car accident, medical negligence, public-place accident, Comcare, TPD), I can narrow this down to **the 3 best Canberra lawyers for your particular type of claim** and compare their fees/reviews/track record.
